  <link rel="manifest" href="/favicon/site.webmanifest">
  <link href="https://api.fontshare.com/v2/css?f[]=satoshi@400,500,700,900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    /* =========================================================
       CSS Custom Properties
       ========================================================= */
    :root {
      /* Core Brand */
      --neon-blue: #00D4FF;
      --neon-blue-bright: #00F5FF;
      --neon-blue-dim: #0088CC;

      /* Backgrounds */
      --base-dark: #0A0F1E;
      --surface: #111827;
      --surface-elevated: #1A1F3A;
      --subtle-blue-tint: #0D1B3D;

      /* Porcelain (from logo) */
      --porcelain-warm: #F0E6D8;
      --porcelain-mid: #E8E0D4;
      --porcelain-shadow: #D4C4B0;

      /* Text */
      --text-primary: #F8F8F8;
      --text-secondary: #9CA3AF;
      --text-muted: #6B7280;

      /* Semantic */
      --color-allowed: #22C55E;
      --color-denied: #EF4444;
      --color-pending: #F59E0B;
      --color-info: #00D4FF;

      /* Hair / Dark Fills */
      --navy-black: #0B1029;
      --navy-mid: #1A1F45;

      /* Dress / Neutral */
      --cool-gray: #C8CCD8;

      /* Code Blocks / Terminal */
      --code-bg: #0D1117;
      --code-text: #E6EDF3;
    }

    /* =========================================================
       Reset & Base
       ========================================================= */
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    body {
      font-family: 'Satoshi', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      background: var(--base-dark);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      min-height: 100vh;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    }

    /* =========================================================
       Particle Canvas
       ========================================================= */
    #particle-canvas {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      z-index: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* =========================================================
       Hero Section
       ========================================================= */
    .hero {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 100vh;
      padding-top: 80px;
      text-align: center;
      max-width: 1000px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding-left: 24px;
      padding-right: 24px;
    }

    /* Hero background glow */
    .hero::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%, var(--subtle-blue-tint) 0%, transparent 60%);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: -1;
    }

    /* ---- Logo / Mascot ---- */
    .hero-logo {
      width: 200px;
      height: 200px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
      position: relative;
      animation: heroFadeScale 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards,
                 subtleFloat 4s ease-in-out 0.8s infinite;
      opacity: 0;
    }

    @keyframes subtleFloat {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-8px); }
    }

    .hero-logo img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: contain;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
    }

    /* Pulsing glow behind logo */
    .hero-logo::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: -20px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
      animation: pulseGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    /* Laser beam container */
    .hero-laser {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      left: 50%;
      width: 0;
      height: 6px;
      transform-origin: 0 50%;
      z-index: 1;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .hero-laser::before {
      content: '';
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #00D4FF, rgba(0, 212, 255, 0));
      box-shadow: 0 0 8px 3px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.5),
                  0 0 20px 6px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.25);
      border-radius: 3px;
    }

    /* Right-side beams */
    .hero-laser--1 {
      transform: rotate(-20deg);
      animation: laserShoot 5s ease-out 1.5s infinite;
    }
    .hero-laser--2 {
      transform: rotate(15deg);
      animation: laserShoot 5s ease-out 3.1s infinite;
    }
    .hero-laser--3 {
      transform: rotate(35deg);
      animation: laserShoot 5s ease-out 4.2s infinite;
    }

    /* Left-side beams — flip origin to shoot left */
    .hero-laser--4,
    .hero-laser--5,
    .hero-laser--6 {
      left: 50%;
      transform-origin: 0 50%;
    }
    .hero-laser--4 {
      transform: rotate(160deg);
      animation: laserShoot 5s ease-out 2.0s infinite;
    }
    .hero-laser--5 {
      transform: rotate(195deg);
      animation: laserShoot 5s ease-out 3.6s infinite;
    }
    .hero-laser--6 {
      transform: rotate(210deg);
      animation: laserShoot 5s ease-out 4.8s infinite;
    }

    @keyframes laserShoot {
      0% { width: 0; opacity: 0; }
      3% { opacity: 0.8; }
      10% { width: 220px; opacity: 0.7; }
      18% { width: 220px; opacity: 0; }
      100% { width: 220px; opacity: 0; }
    }

    @keyframes pulseGlow {
      0%, 100% {
        opacity: 0.7;
      }
      50% {
        opacity: 1;
      }
    }

    /* ---- Brand Name ---- */
    .hero-brand {
      font-size: clamp(3rem, 8vw, 5.5rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-bottom: 20px;
      text-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.2);
      animation: heroFadeUp 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.15s forwards;
      opacity: 0;
    }

    .hero-brand .ava {
      color: var(--neon-blue);
    }

    .hero-brand .kill {
      color: var(--neon-blue);
    }

    /* ---- Tagline ---- */
    .hero-tagline {
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.3em;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--neon-blue);
      margin-bottom: 28px;
      animation: heroFadeUp 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.3s forwards;
      opacity: 0;
    }

    /* ---- Description ---- */
    .hero-desc {
      max-width: 600px;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      animation: heroFadeUp 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.9s forwards;
      opacity: 0;
    }

    .hero-desc p + p {
      margin-top: 12px;
    }

    /* ---- Announcement Pill ---- */
    .hero-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      background: var(--surface-elevated);
      border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.3);
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 8px 20px;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
      animation: heroFadeUp 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.45s forwards;
      opacity: 0;
      text-decoration: none;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .hero-pill:hover {
      border-color: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.6);
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1);
    }

    .hero-pill .badge {
      background: var(--color-denied);
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .hero-pill .pill-text {
      color: var(--text-primary);
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    .hero-pill .arrow {
      color: var(--neon-blue);
      font-size: 1rem;
      transition: transform 0.3s ease;
    }

    .hero-pill:hover .arrow {
      transform: translateX(3px);
    }

    /* ---- Demo Video ---- */
    .hero-video {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      border-radius: 12px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.15);
      background: var(--code-bg);
      box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.10),
                  0 0 120px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.04);
      animation: heroFadeUp 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 0.75s forwards;
      opacity: 0;
    }

    .hero-video-chrome {
      height: 40px;
      background: #161B22;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 0 16px;
    }

    .hero-video video {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
    }

    /* =========================================================
       Entrance Animations
       ========================================================= */
    @keyframes heroFadeScale {
      0% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: scale(0.8);
      }
      100% {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: scale(1);
      }
    }

    @keyframes heroFadeUp {
      0% {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(20px);
      }
      100% {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }

    /* =========================================================
       Shared Section Header
       ========================================================= */
    .section-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      max-width: 864px;
      margin: 0 auto 32px;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .section-title .chevron {
      color: var(--neon-blue);
      margin-right: 8px;
    }

    /* =========================================================
       Quick Start Section
       ========================================================= */
    .quickstart {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      padding-top: 100px;
      padding-bottom: 80px;
    }

    .terminal {
      max-width: 864px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    .terminal-window {
      background: var(--code-bg);
      border-radius: 12px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.08);
    }

    /* Title bar */
    .terminal-titlebar {
      height: 40px;
      background: #161B22;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0 16px;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .terminal-dots {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .terminal-dot {
      width: 12px;
      height: 12px;
      border-radius: 50%;
    }

    .terminal-dot--red { background: #EF4444; }
    .terminal-dot--yellow { background: #F59E0B; }
    .terminal-dot--green { background: #22C55E; }

    .terminal-tabs {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      flex: 1;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .terminal-tab {
      padding: 4px 12px;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      cursor: pointer;
      border-radius: 6px;
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      font-family: inherit;
      transition: color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .terminal-tab:hover {
      color: var(--text-secondary);
    }

    .terminal-tab.active {
      background: var(--surface-elevated);
      color: var(--text-primary);
    }

    .terminal-meta {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .terminal-os {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .terminal-change {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: var(--neon-blue);
      text-decoration: none;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .terminal-change:hover {
      text-decoration: underline;
    }

    .terminal-beta {
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      border: 1px solid var(--text-muted);
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 1px 6px;
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    /* Code area */
    .terminal-code {
      padding: 24px;
      position: relative;
      font-family: 'SF Mono', 'Fira Code', 'Cascadia Code', monospace;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
    }

    .terminal-comment {
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .terminal-prompt {
      color: var(--text-muted);
    }

    .terminal-command {
      color: var(--code-text);
    }

    .terminal-copy {
      position: absolute;
      top: 20px;
      right: 20px;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      border-radius: 6px;
      transition: color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }

    .terminal-copy:hover {
      color: var(--neon-blue);
      background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .terminal-copy svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      fill: none;
      stroke: currentColor;
      stroke-width: 2;
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-linejoin: round;
    }

    /* Copied tooltip */
    .terminal-copy .tooltip {
      position: absolute;
      top: -28px;
      right: 0;
      background: var(--neon-blue);
      color: var(--base-dark);
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-family: 'Satoshi', system-ui, sans-serif;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      white-space: nowrap;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(4px);
      transition: opacity 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .terminal-copy .tooltip.show {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
    }

    .terminal-footnote {
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      margin-top: 20px;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    /* =========================================================
       What It Does Section
       ========================================================= */
    .features {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      padding-top: 100px;
      padding-bottom: 100px;
    }

    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
      max-width: 864px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    .feature-card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 32px;
      transition: border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;

      /* Animate in via IntersectionObserver */
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(16px);
    }

    .feature-card.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
      transition: opacity 0.5s ease, transform 0.5s ease, border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
    }

    .feature-card:hover {
      border-color: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.25);
      box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.05);
    }

    .feature-card.visible:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    .feature-icon {
      color: var(--neon-blue);
      font-size: 2rem;
      line-height: 1;
    }

    .feature-icon svg {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      fill: none;
      stroke: var(--neon-blue);
      stroke-width: 1.5;
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-linejoin: round;
    }

    .feature-title {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-top: 16px;
    }

    .feature-desc {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      line-height: 1.6;
      margin-top: 8px;
    }

    /* =========================================================
       Works With Everything Section
       ========================================================= */
    .integrations {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      padding-top: 100px;
      padding-bottom: 80px;
    }

    .integrations-content {
      max-width: 864px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    .integrations-row {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .integrations-row + .integrations-row {
      margin-top: 16px;
    }

    .integrations-row-label {
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .integrations-row + .integrations-row-label {
      margin-top: 24px;
    }

    .integration-pill {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.15);
      border-radius: 999px;
      padding: 10px 20px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      transition: border-color 0.3s ease, background 0.3s ease;
      /* Reveal animation */
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(10px);
    }

    .integration-pill.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
      transition: opacity 0.4s ease, transform 0.4s ease, border-color 0.3s ease, background 0.3s ease;
    }

    .integration-pill:hover {
      border-color: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.4);
      background: var(--surface-elevated);
    }

    .integration-dot {
      width: 10px;
      height: 10px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .integrations-links {
      text-align: center;
      margin-top: 32px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
    }

    .integrations-links a {
      color: var(--neon-blue);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-weight: 500;
      transition: opacity 0.2s ease;
    }

    .integrations-links a:hover {
      opacity: 0.8;
    }

    .integrations-links .sep {
      color: var(--text-muted);
      margin: 0 12px;
    }

    /* =========================================================
       Featured In Section
       ========================================================= */
    .featured {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      padding-top: 100px;
      padding-bottom: 80px;
    }

    .featured-content {
      max-width: 864px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 24px;
    }

    /* Press cards */
    .press-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 20px;
      margin-bottom: 32px;
    }

    .press-card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border-radius: 16px;
      padding: 40px;
      text-align: center;
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
      /* Reveal animation */
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(16px);
    }

    .press-card.visible {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateY(0);
      transition: opacity 0.5s ease, transform 0.5s ease;
    }

    /* Gradient top border via pseudo-element */
    .press-card::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      right: 0;
      height: 2px;
    }

    .press-card--red::before {
      background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--color-denied), transparent);
    }

    .press-card--blue::before {
      background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--neon-blue), transparent);
    }

    .press-icon {
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      border-radius: 12px;
    }

    .press-icon--red {
      background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1);
      color: var(--color-denied);
    }

    .press-icon--blue {
      background: rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.1);
      color: var(--neon-blue);
    }

    .press-icon svg {
      width: 24px;
      height: 24px;
      fill: none;
      stroke: currentColor;
      stroke-width: 2;
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-linejoin: round;
    }

    .press-pub {
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .press-headline {
      font-style: italic;
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--text-secondary);
      max-width: 300px;
      margin: 0 auto 16px;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

       ========================================================= */
    .sr-only {

      height: 1px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: -1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
      white-space: nowrap;
      border: 0;
    }

    .skip-to-content {
      position: fixed;
      top: -100px;
      left: 16px;
      z-index: 10000;
      background: var(--neon-blue);
      color: var(--base-dark);
      padding: 12px 24px;
      border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px;

    /* =========================================================
       Noise Texture Overlay
       ========================================================= */
    body::after {
      content: '';

      inset: 0;
      z-index: 999;
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: 0.035;
      background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 256 256' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
      background-size: 256px 256px;
    }

       Hero Vignette
       ========================================================= */
    .hero::after {
      content: '';

  <!-- =====================================================
       JavaScript: Particles + Nav scroll behavior
       ===================================================== -->
  <script>
    /* ----- Hero Video: play on 80% visible ----- */
    (function() {
      const video = document.querySelector('.hero-video video');
      if (!video) return;
      const observer = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
        entries.forEach(function(entry) {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            video.play();
          } else {
            video.pause();
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.8 });
      observer.observe(video);
    })();

    /* ----- Particle System ----- */
    const canvas = document.getElementById('particle-canvas');
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    const PARTICLE_COUNT = 80;
    let particles = [];
    let w, h;
    let particleFrameId;

    function resize() {
      w = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
      h = canvas.height = Math.max(
        document.body.scrollHeight,
        document.documentElement.scrollHeight,
        window.innerHeight
      );
    }

    function createParticle(startAtBottom) {
      return {
        x: Math.random() * w,
        y: startAtBottom ? h + Math.random() * 40 : Math.random() * h,
        r: 1 + Math.random(),
        vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.3,
        vy: -(0.15 + Math.random() * 0.35),
        alpha: 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.15
      };
    }

    function initParticles() {
      particles = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) {
        particles.push(createParticle(false));
      }
    }

    function drawParticles() {
      ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
      for (const p of particles) {
        p.x += p.vx;
        p.y += p.vy;
        if (p.y + p.r < 0) {
          p.x = Math.random() * w;
          p.y = h + Math.random() * 20;
        }
        if (p.x < -10) p.x = w + 10;
        if (p.x > w + 10) p.x = -10;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, p.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0, 212, 255, ${p.alpha})`;
        ctx.fill();
      }
      particleFrameId = requestAnimationFrame(drawParticles);
    }

    resize();
    initParticles();
    drawParticles();

    // Pause particles when tab is hidden
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
      if (document.hidden) {
        cancelAnimationFrame(particleFrameId);
      } else {
        drawParticles();
      }
    });

    // Resize handler (100ms debounce)
    let resizeTimer;
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
      resizeTimer = setTimeout(resize, 100);
    }, { passive: true });

    // Resize canvas when page height changes
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      const newH = Math.max(
        document.body.scrollHeight,
        document.documentElement.scrollHeight,
        window.innerHeight
      );
      if (Math.abs(newH - h) > 50) {
        h = canvas.height = newH;
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    /* ----- Scroll reveal (threshold 0.2, fires once) ----- */
    const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.style.transitionDelay = entry.target.dataset.delay || '0ms';
          entry.target.classList.add('visible');
          revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.2 });

    document.querySelectorAll('.feature-card').forEach((card, i) => {
      card.dataset.delay = `${i * 80}ms`;
      revealObserver.observe(card);
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.integration-pill').forEach((pill, i) => {
      pill.dataset.delay = `${i * 40}ms`;
      revealObserver.observe(pill);
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.press-card').forEach((card, i) => {
      card.dataset.delay = `${i * 120}ms`;
      revealObserver.observe(card);
    });

    document.querySelectorAll('.community-card').forEach((card, i) => {
      card.dataset.delay = `${i * 80}ms`;
      revealObserver.observe(card);
    });

    /* ----- Terminal tab switching ----- */
    const commands = {
      pipx: 'pipx install avakill && avakill setup',
      pip: 'pip install avakill && avakill setup',
      hooks: 'avakill hook install --agent all',
      sandbox: 'avakill setup && avakill sandbox verify && avakill launch -- aider',
    };

    const cmdEl = document.getElementById('terminal-cmd');
    const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.terminal-tab');

    tabs.forEach(tab => {
      tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
        tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
        tab.classList.add('active');
        cmdEl.textContent = commands[tab.dataset.tab];
      });
    });

    /* ----- Copy to clipboard (with fallback) ----- */
    const copyBtn = document.getElementById('copy-btn');
    const tooltip = document.getElementById('copy-tooltip');

    function showCopied() {
      tooltip.classList.add('show');
      setTimeout(() => tooltip.classList.remove('show'), 1500);
    }

    function fallbackCopy(text) {
      const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
      ta.value = text;
      ta.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;left:-9999px;top:-9999px';
      document.body.appendChild(ta);
      ta.select();
      try { document.execCommand('copy'); showCopied(); } catch(e) { /* silent */ }
      document.body.removeChild(ta);
    }

    copyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const text = cmdEl.textContent;
      if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).then(showCopied).catch(() => fallbackCopy(text));
      } else {
        fallbackCopy(text);
      }
    });

    /* ----- Live Demo Typing Animation ----- */
    const demoScript = [
      { text: '\u{1F916} Agent: "Let me clean up the old user data for you..."', style: 'color: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.7);', delay: 800 },
      { text: '\u2192 Intercepting tool call: execute_sql', style: 'color: var(--code-text);', delay: 400 },
      { text: '\u2192 Arguments: {"query": "DROP TABLE users CASCADE"}', style: 'color: var(--code-text);', delay: 600 },
      { text: '\u23F3 Evaluating against policy: production.yaml', style: 'color: #4B5563;', delay: 500 },
      { text: '\u274C DENIED by policy: block-destructive-sql', style: 'color: #EF4444; font-weight: 700;', delay: 0 },
      { text: '\u{1F4AC} "Destructive SQL operations require manual execution"', style: 'color: #EF4444;', delay: 800 },
      { text: '\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500', style: 'color: #4B5563;', delay: 300 },
      { text: '\u{1F916} Agent: "I\'ll search for recent user activity..."', style: 'color: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.7);', delay: 600 },
      { text: '\u2192 Intercepting tool call: database_query', style: 'color: var(--code-text);', delay: 0 },
      { text: '\u2192 Arguments: {"sql": "SELECT * FROM users WHERE active = true"}', style: 'color: var(--code-text);', delay: 400 },
      { text: '\u23F3 Evaluating against policy: production.yaml', style: 'color: #4B5563;', delay: 300 },
      { text: '\u2705 ALLOWED by policy: allow-read-operations', style: 'color: #22C55E; font-weight: 700;', delay: 0 },
      { text: '\u2192 Forwarding to database...', style: 'color: #22C55E;', delay: 600 },
      { text: '\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500\u2500', style: 'color: #4B5563;', delay: 0 },
      { text: '\u{1F4CA} Session: 2 calls intercepted | 1 blocked | 1 allowed | 0.3ms avg', style: 'color: #4B5563;', delay: 0 }
    ];

    const demoBody = document.getElementById('demo-body');
    const demoReplayBtn = document.getElementById('demo-replay-btn');
    let demoRunning = false;
    let demoHasPlayed = false;
    let demoAbort = false;

    // Respect reduced motion preference
    const prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

    function typeText(el, text, baseSpeed) {
      if (prefersReducedMotion) {
        el.textContent = text;
        return Promise.resolve();
      }
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        let i = 0;
        function tick() {
          if (demoAbort) { resolve(); return; }
          if (i < text.length) {
            el.textContent += text[i];
            i++;
            const jitter = baseSpeed + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 20;
            setTimeout(tick, Math.max(10, jitter));
          } else {
            resolve();
          }
        }
        tick();
      });
    }

    function demoWait(ms) {
      if (prefersReducedMotion) return Promise.resolve();
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        if (demoAbort || ms <= 0) { resolve(); return; }
        setTimeout(resolve, ms);
      });
    }

    async function runDemo() {
      if (demoRunning) return;
      demoRunning = true;
      demoHasPlayed = true;
      demoAbort = false;

      demoBody.querySelectorAll('.demo-line').forEach(l => l.remove());

      for (const line of demoScript) {
        if (demoAbort) break;

        const el = document.createElement('div');
        el.className = 'demo-line show';
        el.style.cssText = line.style;
        el.style.opacity = '1';
        el.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
        demoBody.appendChild(el);

        await typeText(el, line.text, 40);

        if (line.delay > 0) {
          await demoWait(line.delay);
        }
      }

      demoRunning = false;
    }

    // Trigger demo when scrolled into view
    const demoObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting && !demoHasPlayed) {
          runDemo();
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.3 });

    demoObserver.observe(document.getElementById('demo-window'));

    // Replay button
    demoReplayBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (demoRunning) {
        demoAbort = true;
        setTimeout(() => {
          demoRunning = false;
          demoHasPlayed = false;
          runDemo();
        }, 100);
      } else {
        demoHasPlayed = false;
        runDemo();
      }
    });

    /* ----- Newsletter Form (with validation shake) ----- */
    const newsletterForm = document.getElementById('newsletter-form');
    if (newsletterForm) {
      newsletterForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const input = newsletterForm.querySelector('.newsletter-input');
        if (!input.validity.valid) {
          input.classList.add('shake');
          input.addEventListener('animationend', () => input.classList.remove('shake'), { once: true });
          return;
        }
        try {
          const formBody = `email=${encodeURIComponent(input.value)}`;
          await fetch(newsletterForm.action, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' },
            body: formBody,
          });
        } catch (_) { /* submit even if fetch fails */ }
        newsletterForm.style.transition = 'opacity 0.3s ease';
        newsletterForm.style.opacity = '0';
        setTimeout(() => {
          newsletterForm.outerHTML = '<p class="newsletter-success">Thanks! We\u2019ll be in touch.</p>';
        }, 300);
      });
    }

    /* ----- Site Navigation ----- */
    const siteNav = document.getElementById('site-nav');
    const hamburger = document.getElementById('nav-hamburger');
    const navLinks = siteNav.querySelectorAll('.nav-links a');

    // Hamburger toggle
    hamburger.addEventListener('click', () => {
      siteNav.classList.toggle('nav-open');
    });

    // Close mobile menu on link click
    navLinks.forEach(link => {
      link.addEventListener('click', () => {
        siteNav.classList.remove('nav-open');
      });
    });

    // Scroll shadow
    window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
      if (window.scrollY > 50) {
        siteNav.classList.add('scrolled');
      } else {
        siteNav.classList.remove('scrolled');
      }
    }, { passive: true });

    // Active nav link via IntersectionObserver
    const navSections = document.querySelectorAll('[id$="-section"]');
    const navObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          const id = entry.target.id;
          navLinks.forEach(link => {
            link.classList.toggle('active', link.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
          });
        }
      });
    }, { rootMargin: '-72px 0px -60% 0px', threshold: 0 });

    navSections.forEach(section => navObserver.observe(section));
  </script>
